channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Packrat
item.description: Unified Storage Browser showing the contents of all chests and crates within reach

item.title: Coconut Elk Hoof Sounds
item.description: Changes the trot and gallop sound effects for home recorded coconut ones

item.title: Alternate Elk Hoof Sounds
item.description: Changes the trot and gallop sound effects for sharper ones

item.title: The Quire Patches
item.description: Cohesion patches and a pack guide that keep the Almanac's loaded mod set seamless.

item.title: Chonky Kitchenware
item.description: This mod aims to make your kitchen feel more cozy, giving it a personal touch!

item.title: Chonky Vessels
item.description: Adds chonkier vessels & more with better storage and spoilage properties.

item.title: Custom Server Patch
item.description: A collection of tweaks for our private server.

item.title: xSkills Fork
item.description: RPG-style skill system with abilities, perks, and progression.

item.title: xLib Fork
item.description: XLib provides an interface to add skills, abilities and effects to the game.

item.title: The Almanac: Trades, Callings & Mastery
item.description: Twenty-one trades, Novice to Grandmaster, earned by the work of your hands, not by grinding.

item.title: PALSJ's Fancy Faces
item.description: Adds new faces and the ability to select pieces of each face separately.

item.title: TraderTweaks
item.description: Allow to manage traders

item.title: VS Instruments Redux
item.description: Bring your world to life! Play custom ABC sheet music files on working in-game instruments.

item.title: Metal Cooking Pots
item.description: Adds Cooking Pots made from metal with greater serving size

item.title: Mini's Assorted Patches
item.description: Buncha changes for a LAN

item.title: Arkhavia Patches
item.description: Patches for Arkhavia.

item.title: Hydrate or Diedrate
item.description: A mod that adds thirst and hydration mechanics as well as hot weather survival.

item.title: The Almanac: Illuminated
item.description: A living questbook opened with Alt+J. Chapters appear only for the mods you have loaded.

item.title: xSkills Gilded Fork
item.description: This mod adds a beautifully designed, immersive, and user-friendly interface for xSkills.

item.title: Nimbus - A Server proxy for Vintagestory.
item.description: Put many backends behind one address, move players between them on demand.

item.title: Glider Revamp (Drathon's Fork)
item.description: A fork of Hunter404's Glider Revamp updated to the most recent game version.

item.title: Stability Above
item.description: Removes unstable areas above sea level.

item.title: Chisel Tab
item.description: Adds tabs for blocks that can be chiseled

item.title: Crucible on Forge
item.description: Smelt ore at your forge instead of trekking back to a firepit.

item.title: Floral Zones: Cape Region
item.description: Adds plants from the Cape Region to the game.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Casuariidae Plus
item.description: A collection of Cassowary, Emu and flightless Australian birds from human history.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Sirenia
item.description: A collection of manatee and dugong from the Holocene.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Machairodontinae
item.description: A collection of saber cats from human history.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Caninae
item.description: A collection of dogs from the Holocene.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Capreolinae
item.description: A collection of New World deer from the Holocene.
